messages:
sasha: heads-up — our eu-west-1 canary pool (a100-pool-2) is failing post-driver rollout (NVIDIA 535.19 / CUDA 12.2). Triton / TensorRT pods crash on init. :eyes:
kevin: seeing it too, one pod shows CrashLoopBackOff on the triton deployment. kube logs show plugin load errors.
ops-bot: [alert] Deployment triton-inference/eu-west-1-canary failed 3x in 5m (CrashLoopBackOff).
maria: paste of stderr from one of the pods:
```
[E] TensorRT PluginLoader: failed to load plugin 'flash_attn_plugin'
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  TRT Error: PLUGIN_NOT_INITIALIZED: Plugin registration failed: undefined symbol: _ZN7xformers...
Aborted (core dumped)
```
devon: also seeing NCCL warnings during pod startup: "nccl warning : incompatible operation" on driver upgrade hosts. Might be ABI churn between driver/CUDA and our xformers/flashattn builds.
eli: canary nodes were upgraded via our infra pipeline at 03:10 UTC — driver package 535.19-1 installed. Non-canary (prod) pool still on 525.85.
sasha: good — that explains it. Can we confirm whether this is TensorRT plugin failing (flash_attn/xformers) or lower-level CUDA symbol mismatch?
kevin: dug into the container binary: the binary was built against CUDA 11.8 tooling and xformers pinned to a build that expects older ABI. On 535/CUDA12 host the loader fails on symbol resolution.
maria: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable flash_attn plugin at runtime so Triton falls back to native attention kernel, 2) cordon the upgraded nodes and rollback driver to 525.85, or 3) force deploy a build of xformers/TensorRT plugin compiled against CUDA12.
sasha: downside of (1) — big perf hit on latency and throughput for large contexts, affects SLAs. Downside of (2) — rollout pauses and small window where capacity is reduced (cost may spike if we autoscale other regions).
kevin: I'm going to cordon the 3 canary nodes in eu-west-1 to stop new pods from scheduling, and scale down the canary replica to 0 to reduce noise. executing: `kubectl cordon a100-canary-03 && kubectl scale deploy triton-canary --replicas=0 -n inference`
ops-bot: [cmd] k8s: cordon a100-canary-03 succeeded. triton-canary scaled to 0.
devon: dev note — if we disable flash_attn via ENV we can test quickly: add ENV DISABLE_FLASHATTN=1 to triton container and restart a single canary pod (non-upgraded node) to validate fallback behaviour.
eli: I'll spin a non-upgraded node and attempt the env override test. if it falls back cleanly we have a hotfix that avoids rollback.
maria: filed infra ticket (#INF-2241) and flagged eng-runtime + eng-ml. tagging owners and adding logs, driver package ID, and affected node list.
sasha: longer-term: we need a canary matrix: driver version x CUDA x TRITON/TensorRT/xFormers build compatibility matrix. Also update our model build pipelines to produce CUDA12-compatible plugin artifacts when we expect host upgrades.
kevin: agreed. Also add automatic post-driver-upgrade smoke test that loads all plugins used in runtime within 5m of node upgrade.
devon: cost note — if we rollback driver across eu-west-1 baseline pool, that will reimage ~120 nodes; estimate ~3h ops and extra billing for reimaging windows. Flagging finance for potential overage.
sasha: for now we keep prod untouched. action items: kevin cordon (done), eli run DISABLE_FLASHATTN test, maria keep the ticket updated and include perf delta if fallback tested, devon create compatibility matrix doc PR.
eli: test result — fallback with DISABLE_FLASHATTN=1 allowed Triton to start and serve; latency doubled on the 2048 context benchmark but requests succeed.
sasha: ok that's a workable short-term mitigation. I'll announce to oncall and customers with high-sla models about potential perf regression if they hit eu-west-1.
deploy-bot: [status] rollback not yet executed. awaiting manual approval for node reimage.
kevin: planning retrospective runbook: 1) block host upgrade for remaining pools, 2) coordinate with eng-ml to publish plugin builds for CUDA12, 3) add smoke test, 4) decide rollback window if no plugin build ready in 24h.
maria: adding owners to ticket and setting priority=P0 given customer impact.
sasha: thanks all. keeping thread open for updates.
